prompt_fragment: This asset is a background or texture. Prioritize atmosphere and surface coherence over a single isolated subject.
raw_description:
A cathedral stained-glass window pane. A single cracked and dark
aurora-crystal at center, its light extinguished. Deep violet and
near-black glass panels surround it in void-like stillness, with
muted grey lead lines. Lead-divided jewel-toned glass, ornate
borders. Symbol of silence, forgetting, and unmarked loss.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: Cathedral stained-glass window pane rendered as a 19th-century naturalist plate on aged parchment; fine nib-pen lead lines with painterly glass-on-light register; Gothic altarpiece composition centered in a square field, faint foxing at parchment edges, archival grain beneath
SUBJECT: A single aurora-crystal at center, cracked and dark, its inner light fully extinguished; faceted gem form with deep fissures running through it, surfaces opaque and cold, no glow remaining; the crystal occupies the middle of the pane, composed to survive clipping into a hex wedge
CONTEXT: Full square stained-glass window background; the crystal is the sole focal symbol surrounded by expanding void-like glass panels in deep violet and near-black, the silence radiating outward to ornate Gothic border tracery at the four edges
COLOR: The extinguished crystal rendered in midnight blue-black (#0D1A2D) with cold dark violet undertones; surrounding void panels in deep near-black and muted violet, shadow-dark; lead lines in muted grey rather than black, receding into the dark field; Gothic border accents in warm brown (#6B5548) and aged parchment (#E0D4A8)
DETAILS: Lead lines muted and grey, less assertive than standard cathedral panes, dissolving into the surrounding darkness; cracked crystal surfaces catching no transmitted light; ornate tracery borders intact but somber; glass-on-light register extinguished, producing a lightless, still interior
CONSTRAINTS: No glow, no warmth, no luminosity from the crystal; void stillness throughout; symbol of silence, forgetting, unmarked loss
